finding: ZH4-PASS5 Tier-3 #2 — Cardboard Trade (Solana perp DEX)
title: Cardboard Trade exchange+oracle: price-settle caller-gated to oracle; oracle sources owner-allowlisted -> no E-U path
closed_reasons: exchange settle tag 0x1f is gated on the immediate caller being the oracle program (direct call -> ORCLSKIP no-op, 1361 CU; bypass probes all bail)
oracle push tag 0x07 is permissionless but validates every price-source account by hardcoded program-id allowlist AND specific account keys (bad source -> ORCLSKIP)
oracle instruction data is only 2 bytes (0x071f) -> no price can be supplied by the caller
source-program price accounts are written by authorised updater signers, not permissionlessly
key_facts: USDC vault DSnqZ6ctTToaCMoCwULqdfkXGTTXfQ9oiv3qH98NR4hv holds 1,037,944.751058 USDC; config PDA HrW16vpyqURMvR4CeRf1QYMucEGKusHuzPVz1V3h7R7B (disc CTCFG005)
ELF: pinocchio 0.11.2, stripped; exchange 199,056 B, oracle 101,992 B; disassembled with sbpf
exchange instruction tags observed live: inner 0x1f (settle) and 0x43 (CTEVNT event); oracle top-level 0x07; no top-level user exchange tag observed in 200 recent txs
settle payload: [0x1f][u16 market][u64 price][u64 price][u64 ts][u64 seq]
gate fn_05d0 (exchange.asm:230) compares caller program id to hardcoded oracle id (returns 0x1a); gate fails -> ORCLSKIP exchange.asm:20020
oracle fn_8480 (oracle.asm:4733) validates source owner program-id allowlist (BiSo/Tess/goon/ojh/AQU/ALPHAQ/dijk/fast) plus exact keys DmocjvFX../8mZVRgrr..
sim: direct exchange 0x1f -> ORCLSKIP 1361 CU; oracle push real -> no ORCLSKIP; oracle push swapped source owner -> ORCLSKIP
caveats: Residual: a push with ALL sources invalid still refreshes the feed from last-known prices (stale, not attacker-chosen)
oracle_learning.rs aggregation/TWAP and the exact sysvar caller-read not fully reversed
No top-level user instruction (deposit 0x05 / withdraw / margin) observed live -> those auth paths not exercised
No source/IDL published (upstream repo empty); disassembly-only analysis
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract $0 from Cardboard Trade: the exchange price-settle (0x1f) is caller-gated to the oracle program, and the permissionless oracle push (0x07) assembles prices only from owner-allowlisted, signer-updated source accounts with no caller-supplied price, so the ~$1.04M USDC vault is not reachable.
